about: twig's mutants (wf10 corpus wave 1, PA4): each law's mutant, killed by `ergo test` of its package, and the edits no law or case sees, which TestTwigAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (generated programs against the reference model and the hand Go control) kills.

mutants.name: twig-infix-binds-right
mutants.rule: Every infix operator is left-associative: a - b - c is (a - b) - c (law syntax.PrintParsesBack).

mutants.name: twig-end-token-at-line-start
mutants.from: At: Pos{Line: line, Col: len(src) - lineStart + 1}, Fresh: fresh})
mutants.to: At: Pos{Line: line, Col: 1}, Fresh: fresh})
mutants.rule: The End token stands after every token: a parse error at the end names the place after the last byte (law syntax.TokensStandInOrder).

mutants.name: twig-backslash-never-escapes
mutants.rule: A backslash in a string literal starts an escape, which goes back to the body (law syntax.Quoting.EscapesReturn).

mutants.name: twig-plain-byte-changed
mutants.rule: A byte that is no quote, backslash or newline is itself in the value (law syntax.Quoting.PlainBytesAreThemselves).

mutants.name: twig-escaped-quote-stays-escaped
mutants.rule: After \" the literal goes on in its body (law syntax.Quoting.EscapedQuoteStaysOpen).

mutants.name: twig-slots-never-advance
mutants.rule: Each name a function declares has its own slot, inside the function's frame (law resolve.SlotsFitTheirFrames).

mutants.name: twig-every-name-declared-twice
mutants.rule: A name is declared twice only when its block already declares it; programs that declare distinct names resolve (law resolve.ResolvesSome).

mutants.name: twig-remainder-subtracts
mutants.rule: An int remainder is Go's: the sign of the dividend, wrapping at the extremes (law eval.ArithmeticAgreesWithModel).

mutants.name: twig-reused-frame-keeps-old-values
mutants.rule: A call's variables start nil: a function a block binds, called before the let of a name it reads, reads nil, never a value of an earlier call whose frame was reused.

mutants.name: twig-string-le-is-lt
mutants.rule: <= on strings is true for equal strings.

mutants.name: twig-or-never-short-circuits
mutants.rule: or is true when its left side is, and does not run its right side then.

mutants.name: twig-return-value-on-next-line
mutants.rule: A return's value starts on the return's line: a bare return before another statement returns nil and runs nothing more.
